findings.text: Runtime panic when comparing time.Time with a non-time.Time struct: the type assertion obj2.(time.Time) fails, then obj2Value.Convert(timeType) panics because Go cannot convert unrelated struct types. Failing input: compare(time.Now(), struct{}{}).

0.reason: The code checks CanConvert(timeType) before converting, and struct{}{} cannot convert to time.Time, so it breaks out of the case without panicking.
